title: A.R.M.O.R. order from the server to a node: restart, pause, resume, standby, identify, diagnostics, maintenance
description: An order from the server to one node, published to armor/control/{node_id}/command, or to armor/control/all/command for every node (an `arm` only). Never retained. Two steps, as for a switch: `arm` (the node answers with a one-time `token` bound to the `operation`), then `execute` carrying that token within thirty seconds, to the node's own topic. Operations: restart (a clean restart; settings are kept), pause (the node stops its work for a while and resumes by itself; 60 to 3600 s, 3600 when `duration_s` is absent), resume, standby (the node's work is off, indefinitely and across restarts, but it stays connected and keeps answering; it is not a power-off), identify (blink the node's LED or banner for 5 to 300 s, 30 when absent), diagnostics (a read-only snapshot, or with `detail` the diagnostic package or the log) and maintenance_on / maintenance_off (tells the server to hold back the node-offline alert; 60 to 28800 s, 3600 when absent). `requested_by` is the person the server acted for, kept in the node's log. `mode` `now` acts at once; `rolling` (restart only) waits `slot` times thirty seconds so that nodes never restart together. There is no order that erases a node's settings or credentials, none that puts it into deep sleep and none that sets a wake timer.

node_id.description: The node, or `all` on the broadcast topic (a node cannot be called `all`).

command_id.description: Chosen by the server; the node repeats it in its answer.

operation.description: What to do. The operation an execute carries is the one its token was armed for.

mode.description: now: act at once. rolling: only for restart, wait the slot first.

delay_s.description: Only on a restart execute: seconds to wait before restarting, added to the wait of a rolling slot.

slot.description: Only on a restart execute in mode rolling: the place of the node in the order of the restarts; the node waits slot times thirty seconds.

duration_s.description: Only on an execute of pause (60..3600), identify (5..300) or maintenance_on (60..28800); the range of the operation is enforced besides this one.

token.description: Only on execute: the token the node gave in the answer to the arm.

requested_by.description: Who the server acted for, for the log.

detail.description: Only on the execute of a diagnostics order: `package` asks for the diagnostic package (memory, tasks, why the node last started, versions, the allowed part of the settings, the core dump summary and the newest log, never a secret) and `log` for the newest log alone. Absent: the plain snapshot. A node sends a package or a log at most once every fifteen seconds.
